findings.evidence: Completion.lean:247 defines weightedMapCompletionEquiv and :269 supplies weightedMapCompletionEquiv_apply; both new proofs use only that earlier API and weightedMap formulas.
findings.fix: Move both lemmas to WeightedRestrictedSeries/Completion.lean beside weightedMapCompletionEquiv_apply and export them.
findings.issue: weightedMapCompletionEquiv_coe_weightedC and weightedMapCompletionEquiv_coe_weightedX describe general coefficient equivalences, independent of iteration or Gauss comparisons; making them private hides reusable API.

findings.evidence: The declarations at :82 and :103 mention no series or weights. MulUnit.lean:55 provides Units.isNormMulUnit_iff_norm_inv; Huber/Normed.lean:79 and :96 already develop norm bounds and power-boundedness.
findings.fix: Move the former to Analysis/Normed/Ring/MulUnit.lean and the latter to RingTheory/Huber/Normed.lean.
findings.issue: norm_map_unit_mul_le_one_iff and isPowerBounded_map_mul_of_norm_le are general normed-ring results; their placement forces unrelated users to import restricted-series comparison and evaluation theory.

findings.evidence: Its proof uses only the subring domain instance and Completion.completeRingEquivSelf; Complete.lean:288 already supplies completeSpace_weightedRestrictedSubring_singleton.
findings.fix: Move the instance to WeightedRestrictedSeries/Complete.lean beside the singleton completeness instance.

summary: Several reusable declarations live in comparison modules despite depending only on earlier theory.
